title: QA run · studio-authoring (20/20) · 3fcafcd3 · 2026-10-27 · 17 PASS / 1 PARTIAL / 1 FAIL / 1 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN
body:
Run record — the Studio full sweep the maintainer asked for: every Studio pillar in a real browser, plus every top-level property of Studio's 12 metadata types (per discriminator value), plus the whole `studio-authoring` area. Text only; screenshots were live oracles and are not linked.

## Env fingerprint

- Framework `3fcafcd3b8d93621e400ff2759551ae3930bb7bb`. The console was built from `ui/` in the same tree (`pnpm console:build`; the root `pnpm build` does not populate `packages/console/dist`).
- App: `examples/app-showcase`, `objectstack dev --seed-admin`, `OS_PORT` exported. Each session had its own port and file DB (coordinator 41733; Data 47391; Automations 49109; Interfaces 47613/47614; Access 47631). Admin `admin@objectos.ai`; non-admin personas created per session.
- Runner: coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`, plus four parallel QA sessions (Data, Automations, Interfaces, Access) and two gap-fill agents (view; object/field/hook/action).
- Traps met:
  - `stale-console-bundle`: a console build was needed.
  - `auth-state-leak`: the language preference is stored server-side and a stale storage seed opened English; identity was re-proved per persona.
- Not counted as defects: the server was reaped twice and restarted on the same DB.

## Scope

- Selector: area `studio-authoring` (20 items, 0 planned). All 20 judged.
- Additional coverage, not in the title: the Studio UI clause list (pillar chrome, Data D1–D12, Automations E1–E6, Interfaces F1–F6, Access G1–G6); the property matrix (455 top-level properties across object, field, hook, action, view, app, page, dashboard, report, dataset, flow and permission); the 33 removed keys.

## Per-item verdicts (revision · verdict · text evidence)

| item | rev | verdict | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| first-run-loop | 7 | PASS | 6/6 clauses. New package → object → field → publish → record → app → Home tile, zero restarts (one boot banner) |
| object-designer-roundtrip | 8 | PASS | option label rename persists; keyboard and drag reorder publish in order; label → API name; empty option row ignored |
| view-authoring-live | 3 | PASS | draft receipt `state:draft`; invisible pre-publish; live after publish on a single boot |
| record-page-roundtrip | 9 | PASS | Interfaces session |
| draft-publish-lifecycle | 8 | PARTIAL | c0–c7 and c9–c11 pass. c8: `/diff` names the top-level `widgets` key, not `widgets[0].title` — a checklist-accuracy gap, not a product defect |
| authoring-validation-not-persisted | 4 | PASS | 422 located refusals; nothing persisted; corrected shapes 200 |
| org-override-registry-gate | 5 | PASS | 5/5. Codes are served SCREAMING_SNAKE where the item spells them lowercase (accuracy note) |
| expression-editors | 5 | FAIL | lint parity: RLS USING `f_formula > 5` shows "Valid CEL" and autosaves; publish refuses `rls-predicate-unenforceable` → the F2 card (see list below) |
| permission-matrix-editor-ux | 5 | PASS | acc0–acc5 pass. acc3's wording assumes unruled fields are not editable; that is disputed and carried by a security card (detail withheld pending maintainer) |
| custom-page-render-and-blocks | 1 | PASS | Interfaces session |
| page-variables-and-actions | 1 | PASS | Interfaces session |
| custom-page-source-tiers | 4 | PASS | Interfaces session (react gate checked on a second boot with `OS_PAGE_REACT_ENABLED=false`) |
| packaged-automation-studio-lock | 4 | PASS | A1–A4. Forged draft PUT → 403 ITEM_LOCKED; package-less → 403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE; pin 10/10 when run from `ui/` with `--root .` |
| packaged-display-class-direct-edit | 3 | PASS | Interfaces session |
| metadata-diagnostics-sweep | 9 | PASS | c0–c7. A planted malformed row is located; the outage pin passes 10/10 |
| doc-on-app-menu | 6 | PASS | Interfaces session. The Studio path is not usable (pickers hide gated docs) — accuracy note |
| picklist-bound-select | 3 | BLOCKED{fixture} | the showcase ships no picklist (`GET /meta/picklist` items `[]`); `PUT picklist` → 403 code-only |
| meta-save-preconditions-and-draft-rows | 2 | PASS | If-Match / If-None-Match matrix; `_drafts` labels; history actors |
| multi-package-item-rows | 2 | PASS | two-package dashboard; package-less save/delete 409; mismatch 422; revert semantics |
| save-door-runs-authoring-rules | 3 | PASS | located 422s plus a "did you mean"; draft-then-publish refusal; pins pass |

Pins (RUNNER rule 6), all green at `3fcafcd3`:
- `meta-save-preconditions-and-draft-rows`: 5 files.
- `multi-package-item-rows`: 9 files.
- `save-door-runs-authoring-rules`: 8 files.
- The automation lock pin (10/10).
- `celAuthoring.test.ts` (40/40).
- 23 jsdom pins for four items.

## Reproduction rules for FAIL

- `expression-editors` lint parity: the reproduction is on the F2 card (see list below) (instance 3).
- Security-class findings follow rule 2's carve-out: item / clause / `detail withheld pending maintainer`. They are listed below by card only and were dispatched at once.

## Product defects extracted (each its own card; this record holds the evidence index)

Security (detail withheld pending maintainer; dispatched directly on the maintainer's instruction): #26596, #26597, #26698, #26706.

_The non-security cards (39, `Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27`) are being filed; this list is completed when the batch finishes._

## Property-matrix totals (L1 Studio control · L2 round-trip · L3 runtime effect, for live properties)

- **object, field, hook, action** (Data session + gap-fill):
  - Every no-entry property was written through the draft/publish API and its runtime effect measured.
  - object 18: 3 controls; L2 18/18; L3 15 pass, 3 hit by defects.
  - field 28: 4 controls; L2 28/28; L3 21 pass, 1 inconclusive (`dimensions`), 1 not exercised (`mailAssociation`), 1 not observable.
  - hook 6/6/6.
  - action: L3 24 pass, 4 fail, 2 not exercised.
- **view** (61 properties, gap-fill): 3 Studio controls / 58 no-entry. L2 59 pass, 2 refused by design. L3 48 pass, 5 partial, 4 fail.
- **flow**: 11 Studio gaps (description, successMessage, errorMessage, version, type, variables, runAs, requiredPermissions, errorHandling, `nodes[].inputSchema`, `nodes[].boundaryConfig`), all API-verified. 0 fail. Connector, wait, boundaryConfig and edge-type L3 not run.
- **app / page / dashboard / report / dataset** (Interfaces):
  - app: 11 gaps, 1 fail.
  - page: 2 gaps.
  - dashboard: 1 gap; 9 widget types have no Studio entry.
  - report: 13/13.
  - dataset: no Studio editor by design; all API L3 pass.
- **permission** (36): 24 controls / 12 no-entry; the API-verified ones work at runtime. Round-trip failures are carried by cards.
- **Removed keys**: 33/33 refused at their real location with a retirement prescription.

## Fixture gaps / checklist accuracy

These go to the checklist through the coverage PR that follows this run; they are not extracted as cards.
- `picklist-bound-select` needs a picklist fixture.
- `packaged-automation-studio-lock`'s pin must run from `ui/` with `--root .`.
- `org-override-registry-gate` spells codes in lowercase.
- `draft-publish-lifecycle` c8 expects key-level diff granularity.
- `permission-matrix-editor-ux` acc3 and acc5 wording; step-1 path.
- `doc-on-app-menu`: the Studio path is impossible; create-user needs `mustChangePassword:false`.
- `object-designer-roundtrip` step 1 routes through Setup.

## Off-clause probe

- Duration: the four parallel sessions ran about 06:58–08:22 UTC and the two gap-fill agents until about 09:30 UTC, with coordinator probes before and between them.
- Doors: every Studio pillar in the browser (desktop, 900px and 390px widths; light and dark; en and zh-CN); `/api/v1/meta/*` save/publish/discard/history/diff/rollback/audit/diagnostics; `/api/v1/packages/*`; `/api/v1/data/*`; `/api/v1/security/explain`.
- Boundary classes: phantom and read-only packages; draft-only items; a held edit vs departure; unknown keys; retired keys; foreign references; non-admin personas; runtime changes to metadata already in use.
- Findings: the cards above. Observations not filed (by design or open ledger questions):
  - multiselect/checkboxes save `options:[]` (spec-derived);
  - the publish-drafts 200 + `success:false` envelope;
  - plain DELETE of a draft-only item answers "nothing to delete" (folded into UX feedback);
  - `defaultRowScope` hides rows from the platform admin (needs a ruling);
  - `systemFields.audit:false` rows still carry timestamps;
  - a one-character option value is refused (`too_small`).
